title: Doom 3
description: A first-person shooter set in a science fiction horror universe, where players battle demonic forces unleashed from Hell.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
description: An open-world action-adventure game where players explore the vast kingdom of Hyrule, solving puzzles and battling foes to defeat Calamity Ganon.

title: Angry Birds
description: A puzzle video game where players use a slingshot to launch birds at pigs stationed on or within various structures.

title: Halo: Combat Evolved
description: A first-person shooter where players assume the role of Master Chief, battling alien forces known as the Covenant on a mysterious ringworld.

title: Fortnite
description: An online video game featuring multiple game modes, including a battle royale where players fight to be the last one standing.

title: Minecraft
description: A sandbox game that allows players to build and explore infinite worlds made of blocks, fostering creativity and survival skills.

title: Guitar Hero II
description: A music rhythm game where players use a guitar-shaped controller to simulate playing rock music by hitting notes as they scroll on screen.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog
description: A platform game featuring Sonic, a blue hedgehog with super speed, as he battles the evil Dr. Robotnik to save his animal friends.

title: Shadow of the Colossus
description: An action-adventure game where players control Wander, a young man who must defeat sixteen massive beings known as colossi to revive a girl named Mono.

title: Grand Theft Auto V
description: An open-world action-adventure game set in the fictional state of San Andreas, following three criminals as they commit heists while under pressure from a government agency.
